## Plotting mean monthly costs

`plot_mean_monthly_costs()`

The following function uses [{ggplot2}](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/) to create a plot of monthly costs with a risk table underneath.

Its inputs are as follows:

- `fitted_model`: the `fit` object from models created in the `R/modeling.R` script
- `countdf`: a data frame containing the appropriate count data for cases and controls at each time point, used
to create a risk table

The function uses the [{emmeans}](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=emmeans) function from the package of the same name to estimate monthly costs.  The x-axis (months) is shifted to the right so that the vertical line at x=0 cleanly separates pre-index and post-index months, and cases and controls are dodged slightly so that the error bars do not overlap.

**Used in the analysis:** Figures: [Month-by-month plots](figures.qmd#month-by-month-plots).

```{r}
#| label: plot-mean-monthly-costs
#| eval: false
```

## Total excess costs

`calculate_total_excess_costs()`

This function takes a `fit` object from a model and calculates the total estimated excess costs and confidence intervals.
This object currently only works for models with linear links.
